data.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend `plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh` (delivered by walking-skeleton story 9fee-6947) so that at runtime it detects whether the `bm25s` Python package is importable. When present, ref-query.sh uses bm25s for ranking; when absent, it falls back to the stdlib BM25 implementation and emits a single, well-formed stderr notice without changing exit code or stdout result format.

**Why**: SC-3 explicitly requires the optional-accelerator-with-fallback behavior ("bm25s used as optional performance accelerator if installed, falls back with stderr notice if not"). The walking skeleton story 9fee-6947 covers stdlib BM25, all flags, the 10s budget, and the zero-result stderr signal, but it does NOT require the bm25s accelerator branch — a literal stdlib-only implementation passes 9fee-6947's DDs while leaving SC-3 unsatisfied.

**Scope**:
- IN: bm25s availability detection (try/except ImportError guard); stdlib BM25 fallback path; single-line stderr notice in the fallback case; tests exercising both code paths
- OUT: Adding bm25s to pyproject.toml or any required-dependency manifest (it must remain optional); bit-exact ranking parity between backends (top-N membership equivalence on seed queries is sufficient)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, ref-query.sh detects bm25s availability via a guarded import and uses it for ranking when importable
  ← Satisfies: sc-3  (sc-3: "bm25s used as optional performance accelerator if installed")
- When this story is complete, with bm25s NOT importable, ref-query.sh falls back to stdlib BM25 and writes a single-line stderr notice identifying the fallback; stdout result format is unchanged and exit code is 0 on success
  ← Satisfies: sc-3  (sc-3: "falls back with stderr notice if not")
- When this story is complete, a test (unit or integration) exercises both code paths — one with bm25s importable (or stubbed as importable), one with it explicitly unavailable — and asserts the stderr notice appears only in the fallback case
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, both code paths return results within the 10s budget on the seed corpus
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Implementation] Use a try/except ImportError guard at module load; do not add bm25s to pyproject.toml or any required-dependency manifest — it must remain optional
- [Testing] To simulate bm25s-unavailable in a test, monkeypatch sys.modules or use a subprocess with PYTHONPATH manipulation; do NOT uninstall the package globally
- [Compatibility] Ranking parity is not required to be bit-exact between the two backends; top-N membership equivalence on seed queries is sufficient
- [UX] The stderr notice should be a single line, prefixed (e.g., `[ref-query]`), and emitted at most once per invocation

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a downstream skill author, I want ref-query.sh to use the bm25s accelerator when installed and fall back to stdlib BM25 with a stderr notice when not
